lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee
God in three persons blessed Trinity

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Though the eye of sinful man thy glory may not see
Only Thou art holy; there is none beside Thee
Perfect in power, in love, and purity

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: All Thy works shall praise Thy name in earth and sky and sea
God in three persons blessed Trinity
